headline: Invocation 7 completes the D13 manifold IBP/volume-form milestone on the release pin. New: (1) ManifoldIBP.IntegrableTransfer (integrable_chartMeasure_iff, integrable_globalMeasure_iff, integrable_globalMeasure_withDensity_of_supported): integrability of a chart-supported function against the entropy-weighted glued measure is reduced to integrability of its weighted chart expression, removing the systemic Integrable residual of the atlas IBP layer. (2) ManifoldIBP.PartialChartModelPOU: an explicit smooth step/POU on the half-space atlas (Real.smoothTransition + exists_contDiff_bump) and halfSpaceAtlas_weightedIBP_unconditional, the weighted IBP on the genuinely partial atlas halfSpaceAtlas with NO remaining hypotheses beyond C^2 data and tsupport v inside the base chart source; consumed as halfSpaceAtlas_dirichletEnergy, halfSpaceAtlas_greenIdentity, halfSpaceAtlas_laplacianIntegralZero (the divergence theorem on the partial atlas, via support_laplacian_subset + D12 laplacian_integral_eq_zero) and halfSpaceAtlas_integrable_dirichlet (non-vacuity). (3) ManifoldIBP.POUConstruction: SmoothOverlapAtlas.globalWeightedIBP_of_cover_partial_ae constructs BOTH the partition of unity (from a finite chart cover of the base chart image, via exists_smooth_partitionOfUnity_subordinate, cut down by a ball for compact support) AND the integrability (pointwise target = Phi * 1_source with Phi continuous compactly supported), so no POU/integrability hypotheses remain; applied to the model with base chart 0 (halfSpaceAtlas_weightedIBP_of_cover) and base chart 1 (halfSpaceAtlas_weightedIBP_of_cover_chartOne, test functions supported in {0 < y 0}). The named blockers I4 and U7 of the D12 semantic ledger are discharged with constructed downstream checked uses (HeatKernelBridge.monotoneOn_F_gaussian for I4; the volume measure + chart-independence + constructed POU + unconditional model IBP + Green/Dirichlet consequences for U7). Full release build green (9003 jobs, D6AUDIT VERDICT PASS); 346 audited cones all within {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}; exactly one hard token in the D13 tree (the intentional negative control axiom).
